research:
I found 9 things from the last 14 days (21 Oct to 4 Nov 2026) that a beginner could use or would ask about, plus 1 older offer that may be ending now. About half come from the company's own pages. The rest come only from news sites or blogs, and I've said so on each one.

**Free tools you can use today**

1. **Gemini can now make and edit files inside the chat (29 Oct).** Ask Gemini for a resume, PDF, slides or a sheet, then edit it right there before you download it. Google says it's for all users, free included. **Why a beginner cares:** a student or job-seeker can make a formatted CV or class slides on a free account. **The catch:** only PDFs can be edited on the phone. Docs, sheets and slides need the web version. ([Google blog](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/edit-files-directly/), [Workspace Updates](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2026/10/create-preview-and-edit-files-directly-in-the-Gemini-app.html))

2. **Canva Craft, Canva's own image maker (22 Oct).** It's open to all Canva users through Dream Lab, in the bottom-left panel. It plans the layout and any text first, then draws the image at up to 2K. **Why a beginner cares:** a shop owner or freelancer can make a poster with readable text for free. **Related:** Canva Brush, a design-editing AI that launched 29 Oct, is for paying Pro users only for now. ([Canva newsroom](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-craft/), [Fast Company on Brush](https://www.fastcompany.com/91633207/could-canva-brush-new-ai-feature-end-graphic-design-slop))

3. **NotebookLM now lives inside Gemini too (23 Oct).** NotebookLM was renamed "Gemini Notebook" in July, and from 23 Oct you can open it from inside the Gemini app. Since 19 Oct you can also change the outline of a slide deck or video before it's made. **Why a beginner cares:** people searching for "NotebookLM" may not find it under the new name, so it's a good "where did it go?" explainer for students. **Source:** blogs only, not Google, so check before using this. ([Mean CEO blog](https://blog.mean.ceo/notebooklm-news-october-2026/), [AI Career Lab](https://theaicareerlab.com/blog/notebooklm-is-now-gemini-notebook-2026))

4. **Galaxy AI on Samsung phones works in more languages (announced 14 Oct, rolling out "in the coming weeks").** It starts with the translate, transcribe and summarise features. Samsung's list of 24 languages includes Hindi and English (India). **Why a beginner cares:** it's AI already on millions of Indian phones, no app needed. **The catch:** it's unclear whether Hindi is new in this update. Apple still has no Hindi date for Apple Intelligence. ([Samsung Newsroom](https://news.samsung.com/global/samsung-expands-language-support-across-ai-experiences-on-galaxy))

**Privacy and confusion**

5. **ChatGPT "locked chats" (20 Oct, one day before the window, still rolling out).** These hide chosen chats behind a 4-digit PIN or your phone's lock. **Why a beginner cares:** it's useful on a shared family phone, but people will assume "locked" means private. OpenAI's own help page says it is not encryption, it doesn't change how long your chats are kept, and anyone who opens the chat can copy it. That makes a clean "what AI privacy really means" explainer. ([OpenAI Help](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001411-using-locked-chats-in-chatgpt))

6. **Separate Meta AI chats in WhatsApp (beta, 4 Nov).** You'll be able to start more than one chat with Meta AI, like separate topics, from your chat list. **Why a beginner cares:** WhatsApp is where most Indian beginners meet AI. **The catch:** it's only on some Android beta testers for now, so don't present it as live for everyone. ([WABetaInfo](https://wabetainfo.com/whatsapp-is-rolling-out-chats-powered-by-meta-ai-on-android/))

7. **"Is CapCut inside ChatGPT now?" Not yet.** CapCut announced a ChatGPT plugin on 24 Oct: you'd write an idea in ChatGPT, get a draft video, then finish it in CapCut's web editor. There's no release date or price. **Why a beginner cares:** people will search for it and find nothing, so this is a "here's what's real" moment. **Source:** news coverage only. ([Soyacincau](https://soyacincau.com/2026/10/26/capcut-is-coming-to-chatgpt-letting-you-create-videos-directly-inside-chat/), [Yahoo Tech](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/copilot/articles/capcut-adding-chatgpt-plugin-see-155530723.html))

**Scams**

8. **Deepfake videos of leaders selling fake government schemes (I4C alert, about 19 Oct).** The government's cybercrime centre (I4C) flagged Facebook and Instagram ads using fake videos of the PM, finance ministers and chief ministers. The ads push made-up schemes, then ask for an "advance fee" or a UPI payment. **What to do:** report it at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. **Source:** I couldn't find the I4C document itself, only news coverage. ([Forensicspot](https://forensicspot.com/news/i4c-flags-deepfake-videos-impersonating-indian-leaders-to-promote-fake-governmen), [Sarkaritel](https://www.sarkaritel.com/chief-minister-impersonation-scam-alert/))

9. **Voice-clone "family in trouble" calls and deepfake "digital arrest" videos (Punjab National Bank warning, late Oct).** PNB warned customers about calls in a relative's cloned voice and fake videos of police threatening arrest. One industry report says a few seconds of your recorded voice is enough to copy it. **What to do:** agree a family code word, and call back on the saved number. **Source:** news reports of the bank's warning, not PNB's own page. ([NewsMobile](https://www.newsmobile.in/fraud-and-scam/pnb-alerts-customers-to-ai-voice-cloning-deepfake-and-phishing-frauds/), [Asianet](https://newsable.asianetnews.com/india/ai-voice-scam-how-cybercriminals-clone-family-members-voices-to-trick-you-into-sending-money-articleshow-w7eerwl))

**Worth checking**

10. **The free ChatGPT Go year in India may be ending for early sign-ups.** This isn't new: OpenAI gave a free 12-month ChatGPT Go plan to people in India who signed up during an offer that started 4 Nov 2025. That suggests the first free years run out around now, which would leave people asking "why is ChatGPT asking me to pay?" That's my reading of the dates, not something OpenAI has said. Check OpenAI's own page before building a reel on it. ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/technology/tech-news/chatgpt-go-free-one-year-plan-india-openai-details-step-by-step-125110400200_1.html))

I left out model launches (GPT-6.x, Claude Opus 5.5) and US-only features like ChatGPT over iMessage. India's AI-labelling rules aren't new: they've applied since 20 Feb 2026.

**How these fit this week's plan:**
- Items 1 and 2 suit the tutorial or tool slots.
- Items 5, 8 and 9 suit the explain kind with hook #2, the AI-goes-wrong angle (2 of its 3 uses are left this week).
- Items 8 and 9 would use the SAFE keyword. Its free tool still needs checking before you use it.
